parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
A stationary nucleus of uranium-238 ($^{238}_{92}\text{U}$) decays to form a nucleus of thorium-234 ($^{234}_{90}\text{Th}$). An $\alpha$-particle and a gamma-ray photon are emitted. The equation representing the decay is

$$^{238}_{92}\text{U} \rightarrow ^{234}_{90}\text{Th} + ^{4}_{2}\text{He} + ^{0}_{0}\gamma$$

The masses of the nuclei are given in Fig. 12.1.

{{figure:figure_12_1}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State the relationship between the binding energies of the nuclei that is consistent with this reaction being energetically possible.
